requirement_match.summary: Visual-v2 matches explicit request for prettier and clearer dashboard inside original approved frontend scope: larger typography and values, blue intake anchor, unified toolbar, stronger refresh, aligned charts and action badges.

security.summary: Existing authenticated callable and staff checks retained; no backend, writes, PII, secrets or dependency edits. Permission denial clears old private counts; unmount invalidates async ownership.

code_quality.summary: Only scoped CSS changed since v1 manifest; original logic/test files unchanged. Scoped ESLint/Prettier and real Vite browser compilation passed. No extra dependency or global style edit.

failure_paths.summary: Current seven-test browser run passed loading, empty, capped-zero, partial, stale retry, permission, malformed data, race/unmount, keyboard, 1440/390/320 and CSS text scaling.

error_handling.summary: Existing error/data semantics and complete string inventory unchanged. All eight principles re-reviewed against new screenshots, contrast ratios and seven state tests.

production_readiness.summary: Readiness assessed: local implementation validated; production NOT_READY. No build artifact, deployment, provider or global shared-worktree release certification. Rollback reverts scoped frontend files only.

trade_offs.summary: Counts retain existing UTC cap/overlapping semantics. No sums, funnel or invented financial metrics; destination filters differ and are disclosed. Charts use CSS and textual values without a library.

residual_risks: Inherited 100-record/overlapping counts remain bounded; no revenue or trend inference.
Shared worktree changes can stale global runtime signatures; v2 scoped manifest binds review.
limitations: No deployment/provider, other engine or real screen-reader certification.
No TypeScript/unit rerun required for CSS-only refinement; current browser compilation and state tests passed.
Optional indexes degraded; current source/style and hash boundary verified.
Current shared app integration recheck did not render overview within timeout. Visual evidence is real component with explicit synthetic transport; v1 emulator data is not recertified.
